description: Find US listed ETFs by ticker, fund name, or a word from the name. Suited to a fund named loosely: etf_profile then takes the ticker it returns. Refuses rather than returning a near match: a refusal says why, and for a fund it means ETFIQ does not publish it. A former ticker (SPLG) answers with the fund it trades as now, and a closed fund with its page and the day it closed. Funds filed with the SEC that do not trade (prediction markets, sports teams) come back in filed, with how many are filed and how many trade, never as results.

desk.description: Optional: only funds on this desk, as the index labels it, such as income, buffer, leverage, crypto, alternatives, themes or core.

query.description: A ticker, a fund name or a word from the name, case-insensitive, such as JEPI or semiconductor.

name: etf_search

as_of.description: Date of the newest number in the answer.

citation.description: A ready citation string with the as-of date and the page address.

data.description: The answer, or null when ETFIQ refuses (then error and reason say why).

disclaimer_required.description: True when the answer carries numbers that need the not-advice line.

error.description: Present only on a refusal: what ETFIQ does not publish.

provenance.description: Where each number came from: field, source, as_of, source_uri.

reason.description: Present only on a refusal: why, and what to change.

tried.description: Present only on a refusal: what was looked up.

warnings.description: Caveats to show with the answer.
